description: Compare a claimed business Name/Address/Phone against listings the free OpenStreetMap business search finds near the claimed location. PARTIAL scope: checks ONE open source, not a multi-directory citation crawl (a multi-directory crawl needs licensed directory-API access this deployment does not have). A found field with no value is reported notComparable, never scored as a mismatch. `overallScore` on each match is a mean of comparable-field similarities (0-1), null when nothing was comparable.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

radiusKm.description: Search radius around the claimed location, in km.

name: run_local_nap_audit
